topic: Debouncing API requests in React and Flutter to prevent performance lag

post.topic: Debouncing API requests in React and Flutter to prevent performance lag
post.linkedin_text:
Stop letting every keystroke hammer your API.

Searching on every single character change wastes bandwidth and kills performance.

Here is how to debounce your inputs properly.

In React, a simple custom hook using setTimeout and clearTimeout handles it cleanly.

In Flutter, the easy way is using a Timer inside your text controller listener.

• Delay execution until the user stops typing for 400ms
• Cancel the previous timer on every new event
• Save server resources and keep UI silky smooth

How do you usually handle search debouncing in your apps?

slides.title: Stop Hammering Your API With *Keystrokes*
slides.body: How to debounce search inputs in React and Flutter.

slides.title: The Problem with Raw Inputs
slides.body: Firing an API request on every single onChange or text change creates unnecessary network traffic and lagging UI updates.

slides.title: React Debounce Hook
slides.body: Use useEffect and setTimeout to delay API calls until typing stops.

slides.title: Flutter Timer Pattern
slides.body: Dispose active timers in your controller listener to achieve the same effect.

slides.title: The Result
slides.body: Cleaner network tabs, lower server costs, and a much smoother experience for your users.
